lab_title: What fits in the assumed single device?
lab_assumptions: Hypothetical dense 8B model: 32 layers, 8 KV heads, head dimension 128; KV stays FP16. Fixed four-GiB runtime reserve. Raw estimates omit real allocator/quantisation overhead; no model, GPU or throughput measurement.
